FintechOS Raises $28 Million in Combined Debt and Equity
summary:
Fintech enablement platform FintechOS has closed $28 million in combined debt and equity. The funding, when added to the company’s previous rounds, boosts FintechOS’s total funding to $178.9 million since it was founded in 2017. Today’s equity funds come from existing investors Bek Ventures, IFC, Cipio Partners, and Molten Ventures. The debt facility comes from Santander Read more...
The post FintechOS Raises $28 Million in Combined Debt and Equity appeared first on Finovate.
content: Fintech enablement platform FintechOS has raised $28 million in combined debt and equity funding. This latest round brings the company's total funding to $178.9 million since its founding in 2017. The equity portion was supported by existing investors including Bek Ventures, IFC, Cipio Partners, and Molten Ventures, while the debt facility was provided by Santander.
content_ta: Fintech enablement platform ஆன FintechOS, கடன் மற்றும் ஈக்விட்டி மூலம் மொத்தம் $28 மில்லியன் நிதியை திரட்டியுள்ளது. இந்த புதிய நிதி திரட்டல் மூலம், 2017-ல் தொடங்கப்பட்ட இந்நிறுவனத்தின் மொத்த நிதி $178.9 மில்லியனாக உயர்ந்துள்ளது. இதில் Bek Ventures, IFC, Cipio Partners மற்றும் Molten Ventures உள்ளிட்ட முதலீட்டாளர்கள் ஈக்விட்டி நிதியை வழங்கியுள்ளனர், மேலும் Santander நிறுவனம் கடன் வசதியை அளித்துள்ளது.

Maryland’s Personalized Pricing Ban Marks Shift From Disclosure to Prohibition
summary:
Maryland will become the first state to put an outright ban on certain personalized grocery prices into effect Oct. 1, moving beyond the disclosure requirements that have defined much of the early state response to algorithmic pricing. But it may not be the last. Maryland Gov. Wes Moore signed the Protection From Predatory Pricing Act […]
The post Maryland’s Personalized Pricing Ban Marks Shift From Disclosure to Prohibition appeared first on PYMNTS.com.
content: Maryland is set to become the first U.S. state to enact an outright ban on certain personalized grocery pricing. Moving beyond previous disclosure requirements, Maryland Governor Wes Moore signed the Protection From Predatory Pricing Act, which takes effect on October 1. This legislation marks a significant shift from simple transparency to total prohibition of algorithmic pricing practices, potentially setting a precedent for other states to follow.
content_ta: குறிப்பிட்ட தனிப்பயனாக்கப்பட்ட மளிகைப் பொருள் விலை நிர்ணயத்திற்கு நேரடித் தடை விதிக்கும் முதல் U.S. மாநிலமாக Maryland மாறவுள்ளது. முந்தைய வெளிப்படைத்தன்மை விதிகளைத் தாண்டி, Maryland கவர்னர் Wes Moore, Protection From Predatory Pricing Act சட்டத்தில் கையெழுத்திட்டுள்ளார். அக்டோபர் 1 முதல் அமலுக்கு வரும் இந்த சட்டம், எண்கணித விலை நிர்ணய நடைமுறைகளுக்குத் தடையை ஏற்படுத்துவதோடு, பிற மாநிலங்களுக்கும் ஒரு முன்னுதாரணமாக அமைகிறது.

summary: A workers union wants exemptions and/or a one-off payment for employees with long commutes and those who provide long-term care. The bank is requiring U.K.-based staff to come in three days a week.
content: Barclays employees and a workers union are pushing back against the bank's return-to-office clampdown. The bank now requires its U.K.-based staff to work from the office three days a week. In response, the union is requesting exemptions or one-off financial payments for employees facing long commutes and those responsible for providing long-term care.

content: Egypt-based FinTech company Paymob has secured $35 million in pre-Series C funding. The post Urban Institute Urges Guardrails as Governments Experiment With Agentic AI appeared first on PYMNTS.com.
content: The Urban Institute has released new guidance urging state and local governments to establish governance structures before adopting autonomous agentic AI systems. As public sector agencies begin experimenting with artificial intelligence capable of independent action, the institute's new playbook emphasizes the critical need for proper guardrails to ensure accountability and safety before these technologies become deeply embedded in public services.
